dependency_classes.migration_policy: move content atomically to canonical units 5, 6 and 7; do not overwrite before destination paths and references are ready
regenerate course index, unit index, previous/next navigation and canonical pages in the same pull request
preserve identifiers where semantically stable; add canonical_unit and legacy_unit metadata when renaming would break traceability
classify each file as active contract or historical provenance before changing a path; never bulk-rename
retain immutable historical numbering and connect it through this crosswalk; do not rewrite completed audit history
do not clone or renumber validators mechanically; retire or replace them with generic course/unit validation after the atomic migration

critical_findings.finding: Numeric public URLs are semantic identifiers today. Reusing unidad-04.html for a different topic changes the meaning of existing bookmarks.
critical_findings.required_control: introduce stable slug-based canonical URLs or an explicit legacy mapping before repurposing numeric pages

critical_findings.finding: Unit-specific validators and workflows encode legacy paths and unit numbers.
critical_findings.required_control: migration must update or retire all path-sensitive checks in the same pull request

critical_findings.finding: Practice, assessment and review artifacts use unit numbers as part of filenames and internal identifiers.
critical_findings.required_control: separate canonical sequence from historical provenance through explicit legacy_unit/canonical_unit metadata

critical_findings.finding: Historical audits are evidence of prior states and must not be silently rewritten to match the new sequence.
critical_findings.required_control: preserve historical files and reference them through the migration crosswalk

atomic_migration_gates: all destination unit sources exist before source paths are removed
course and unit indexes expose ten canonical units
public previous/next navigation is continuous from 1 to 10
legacy references resolve through documented aliases or crosswalk metadata
practice and assessment references point to the intended canonical domains
unit-specific CI path filters cannot silently skip migrated files
generic curriculum, unit, bibliography, redundancy, public-alignment and link checks pass
course remains review or pending until documented human disciplinary review
